name_server.description: List of DNS servers to use for queries (if empty, uses target's SOA servers)

dictionary.description: Path to dictionary file for brute-force subdomain enumeration

filter_wildcard.description: Filter out records that resolve to wildcard IPs during brute-force

axfr.description: Attempt AXFR zone transfer on all NS servers

spf_reverse.description: Reverse lookup IPv4 ranges from SPF record

whois_deep.description: Deep Whois analysis and reverse IP lookup

zone_walk.description: Perform DNSSEC zone walk using NSEC records

threads.description: Number of concurrent threads for parallel operations

tcp.description: Use TCP instead of UDP for DNS queries

db.description: SQLite3 database file to persist results

continue_wildcard.description: Continue brute-forcing even if wildcard records are detected

disable_recursion_check.description: Skip recursion available check on target NS servers

disable_bindversion_check.description: Skip BIND version detection via TXT queries

enumeration_type.description: List of enumeration types to perform (e.g., ['std', 'axfr']) — valid types: std, rvl, brt, srv, axfr, bing, yand, crt, snoop, tld, zonewalk
